'''Squinquargesimus''' was a village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quelii]]. It was the birthplace of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] Alek,<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 31">[[Knights of the Old Republic 31|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 31]]</ref> who fought in the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and later became a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] by the name of [[Darth Malak]]&mdash;one of the instigators of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> In his youth he was nicknamed "Squint", a reference to both his birthplace and his steely gaze.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref>
